The good phone and the bad battery. I am a Moto fan for a few years. I bought 2 Moto G6 on prime day to replace Moto E4 and Moto E4 Plus. I bought a black Moto G6 and Oyster Blush Moto G6 for my wife. After spending one day with the black Moto G6, my battery drained to 15% in 10 hours. I had about 87% 6am and %15 at 4pm. It was a normal day use like I always do with my previous Moto E4 Plus. I ordered a replacement and Amazon sent me. Again same problem. Battery drained very fast. I had 100% 6am and ~60% by 2pm. The weird thing is that the Oyster Blush works ok. Its battery holds. I don't know what is the problem with the black Moto G6 battery. Maybe a bad batch or something. Beside that the phone is ok.

A very good phone. The Moto G6 is a very good phone. It comes in several versions. The charger cables are not interchangeable. I have 2 Moto G6 phones. The phones will work on both cell towers or internet. The screen quality is very sharp. The battery life is very good. I like the fingerprint reader because no one else can use the phone with out me there.

I like the Moto G series but the G6 phone stopped charging.. I like the Moto G series. I had the G5 and upgraded to the G6. I gave the G5 to a family member and that phone is still running great. I'm a disappointed with the G6. I had the phone for 14 months and now the phone won't charge.

Incidentally, My Moto G6 is a replacement for a different Samsung that failed me. Both my daughter and I have been completely satisfied with this phone and have no trouble whatsoever. If you are in the market for a Tracfone smartphone, I would look at the Moto G6

Moto G6...great mobile for the 💰. I always have liked Motorola phones. This Moto G6 is very nice and comes with many interesting great features. clapping hands clapping hands clapping hands heart suit it

Moto G6 Great Value for the Price. I would return the Moto G6 if I could. I didn't realize until recently a major flaw in my opinion. The screen goes black in a few seconds when you are talking or making changes. It may be good for battery life, but it makes simple things hard to do. Premium phone, discount price!. I've been using the Moto G6 for a few fays now and I'm impressed. My previous phone was an LG G4. The LG was a bit bigger and a lot more expensive, but I don't notice any appreciable difference in performance. The Moto G6 has much better cell and WiFi reception than the LG. The Moto screen is crisp and clear, and very responsive. All of the apps I used on the LG work flawlessly on the Moto. My only 2 issues so far are that the Moto does not have a user replaceable battery, and there is no easy way to rearrange the navigation buttons on the screen. However, at around $200, versus around a thousand or so for some of those so called flagship phones, I can live with a couple very minor inconveniences.

Does not work with the Sprint network. I chatted online and also stopped into the Sprint store to activate the Moto g6. Both of them said the Moto g6 is not compatible with the Sprint network so the headline for this phone on Amazon needs to remove the Sprint network because it does not work. Very dissapointed!
the phone looks like new.. The Moto g6 is working flawlessly and it exceeded my expectations.

Customer support appears to be a scam. Has this happened to anyone else?. Very soon after my TracFone Moto G6 arrived it stopped booting up on startup correctly. I contacted TracFone customer support and, after going through all the remote attempts to solve the problem, was told that they would replace it with a new Moto G6 if we sent in the original phone. They sent an envelope and we mailed it to them. We then got a refurbished Samsung J3. We called and after an hour on the phone were promised, very explicitly, that they would send a new Moto G6. A week later we got another refurbished Samsung J3. I called and was told they decided that they had no more Moto G6's in stock (not true according to amazon listing I purchased it from) and this was considered an equivalent.

Late on O/S Updates. Phone is good so far, but I upgraded from Amazon Moto G5 to G6 and G5 has Android 8.1 as latest O/S, G6 has 8.0. 9.x is supposed to be out now for G6, but Amazon hasn't made it available, at least on my unit.

Another Moto winner. Great phone! Moto G4 was my 1st Moto & decided then & there that Moto would be my phone. G6 is even better. Easy to use, beautiful, even more refined. Everything I want in a phone. Thanks Moto!

Moto G6 is a great phone. Love this phone, great price, nice size, Moto features, and eventually getting Android Pie update
Moto G6: Excellent Inexpensive Option. Had my G6 for 6 months, charges exceptionally fast but drains almost as quickly. Fast processor, good video, fingerprint works well. All in all thumbs up .

A great value MOTO G6. Has a great camera. Everything functions as it should. Compares with phones costing much more.

I will give this phone a rating of 5. I Love this phone. For the price you will not find a better high end quality phone. I love the moto g series line.

I liked the Moto G6 better than the Samsung Galaxy J3 Orbit I was sent (also reconditioned - 90 day warranty) but at least it works. I just have to throw out the case, screen savers and charger that I no longer have a use for.

Not Good on T-Mobile. I bought the Amazon Prime Moto G6 for my Wife and I. Previously had the Moto E (4th Generation) Amazon Prime for my Daughter. The Moto G6 has many dead spots when the Moto E(4th Generation) has a strong signal. The phone itself is fine, but if you have no reception... there is not any point. T-Mobile support has been of little to no help... there must be something about this phone and their network. Maybe it's all networks as we never used these on another carrier.

The camera is not as good as new flagship cameras for sure, but it is good enough for me. For those who are curious, most of the Amazon extras can be uninstalled, and they can all be at least disabled (including the widget), but some of the apps were ones I would have intentionally downloaded anyways, so I see no reason why people are against the Amazon version. No ads on the lock screen and no intrusive notifications. I have been using it on Verizon, and the only bummer is that I can't get calls over WiFi. Hopefully the Android P update will bring that. I bought this case and a screen protector with it, and they've been great: Moto G6 Screen Protector... Moto G6 Case,Yiakeng Dual... Overall I would definitely recommend this phone.

Only two things I dislike about the moto g6. The fact I can't cast to my roku tv without having a google chrome cast and no NFC. I can live without both, but it would be nice to be able to make purchases with phone if it had NFC. I can definitely recommend this phone for those that have had sub 200 dollar phones. Try this one and you will love the speed and quality of the Moto G6.

Great Motorola Smartphone At A Great Price!!!. I bought this Moto G6 smartphone because I knew it would be great having purchased Moto or Motorola smartphones in the past and I am glad I bought this one. Its very fast having 4GB ram, large 64GB of storage, long battery life, a nice blue color, Amazon apps to use, unlocked to use WITH ANY mobile phone company, all this and more. All in all I am very happy with the Moto G6 smartphone and I am glad I bought it.

Love this Motorola G6 Phone. I like the slim design and the Oyster Blush color. The features are easy to use and I have not had any problems with this Motorola - Moto G6 Smartphone, 32GB Memory, Unlocked without SIM Card phone.
I am really disappointed. A friend has this phone also, and has the same problem. There just isn't enough clarity on the Moto g6 for hearing impaired people.
Happy with my G6. Excellent battery life, double my Moto X. A good phone, good sound, good photos.

Keeps "cutting out". I'm having problems with the phone cutting out during conversations. My Moto G4 didn't have this problem. I have had the Moto G6 for three weeks, and it cuts out almost every time I talk to someone. Very frustrating.

I have been using a first gen Moto G for nearly four years. It has been reliable and stable all that time, and the battery is still working great. The only problem is apps like Facebook are getting to be too intensive, so I was excited to upgrade to the Moto G6 during the Prime Day deal. I'm hoping I just got a defective G6 because all I have on it are the Amazon and Google apps and it's already crashed four times today. Amazon has said they will refund me, but in order to get a replacement I had to order another G6. I'll update this review when I get the new phone--hopefully, the replacement will be closer to my great experience with the first gen Moto G.

It's a Moto! That says it all.. My wife was driven to distraction by her Samsung. She knew I loved my Moto G4 and after I got her to consider and look the Moto over, she said let's do it. Now she would probably hurt you if you tried to take her G6 from her and give her a Samsung. AIN'T GOING TO HAPPEN!

Very slippery!. I bought the Moto G6 as a successor to my Moto X2. I really like the Moto software: moto display, gestures and attentive display. I like the G6 and how it runs. However, I'm going to have to return it because of the all glass construction. It is just TOO slippery: hard to hold onto, and slides easily on many surfaces. It's fallen many times since I bought it. My X2 has never fallen in the 4 years that I've had it. I haven't been able to find a case that works for me. Mobile phone manufacturers - please discontinue the glass backs on all these phones - very impractical.

So far love this phone. This Moto G6 is an excellent phone for me. Easy to set up and easy to use. Switched from a Samsung s5 and am glad I did. Samsung has put themselves out of my price range. The G6 is a great value for the money. Only drawback is OtterBox doesn't make a case for it yet that I have found.

Best phone for the money. You CAN'T beat the price Amazon had this phone for. My wife and I both have Moto G4's, unfortunately her's started to have problems. After researching MANY of the Moto Phones, I ended up buying her the G6. The price and what you get for it, is well worth it.

Everything about the Amazon MOTO g6 and Amazons software has taken over my sim card. I never got pop up ads on my LG and now that I have switched back I get pop ups every time I do something on it. Buying the MOTO g6 this way was a terrible move. I read on google that Amazon was suppose to be putting out an update for this phone to do away with the pop ups and the adware but I have not seen or received it.

Prior to this phone I had used a moto g5 plus. I saw little to no difference between the g6 and the g5 plus. The g5 plus battery was excellent, I could frequently get away with charging it every other day with light use. The only difference I appreciated in the g6 was the usb-c charger.

Good for the price. I'll start off by saying that I knew what I was getting for the price. I'm "upgrading" from the Moto X Pure Edition (aka XPE). Long story short, battery was worthless and when I tried replacing it the screen broke. I considered both the G6 and X4, but ultimately bought the G6. Pros: Screen size - I like the 5.7" like the XPE whereas the X4 shrunk to 5.2 Price Performance - i had doubts before but it's definitely enough for me Fingerprint scanner - surprised to see at this price point.
Awesome. I love this phone. I had an old Galaxy s6. The Moto G6 feels like a decent upgrade from that. I got mine for $170 which was a great price.
The phone now has a USB c port instead of micro and 64gb built in storage!. Love the Moto g6 I got the Amazon Prime version!

Lousy sensitivity. The G6's sensitivity is lousy. I was hoping that it's sensitivity would be better than my MOTO G3's, but no - it's just as lousy as the G3. In a hotel room, my wife had her MOTO E2 in her left hand and my MOTO G6 in her right hand. Her E2 showed 4 bars of service signal strength. My G6 showed NONE. Extremely disappointing. Spent the extra money with nothing to show for it. Motorola sent me a satisfaction survey after my purchase. I gave the phone a very poor rating and explained why in the notes section. Haven't heard back from them, implying that customer satisfaction is not a priority. Sad. A brand name with the longevity and reputation of Motorola dropping the ball like this. Sad, sad, sad.
nice phone, but I had bluetooth problem. Everything was fine and my wife loved Moto G6 64G. But I couldn't connect phone to Honda CR-v (2013) through Bluetooth. Old Moto Droid Turbo 2 works it good.

Love the Moto G6. Although I didn't purchase my Moto G6 here for this great price, I'm happy that this is my best Tracfone yet. My phone number, minutes, texts, contacts, photos, and apps all transferred from my LG in less than 10 minutes. The Moto is feature rich along with great speed, long battery life, super camera, loud volume, and rapid charge. It does have its own way of doing things, so I had to sit down with it to learn how to do everyday things like sending texts with photos to multiple contacts. All in all, it's a fantastic phone!
Moto g6 earphone Jack has a problem, but Motorola customer service is BEST!!!. Motorola customer service helped to solve the problem quick and properly. I appreciate it.
So up pops the Moto G6 for at the time of purchase $150. So I bought it now after many months of using it as my daily driver lets get down and talk shop on how this device is.

Worked for a few months and now it's shutting down and won't restart unless I use volume down and power , my other G6 Moto phones lasted much longer than this one and actually 2 of my G6plays are still working great but have broken screens and they are older models by two years

Very nice phone. I’ve always been a Tracfone user and they have a nice range of phones to choose from both price-wise and brand-wise. I had to travel to the Mainland and when my airline app was too “advanced” for my old Samsung Stardust phone, I knew it was time to upgrade my smartphone. I wanted a phone with a better camera and more storage. I chose the Motorola Moto G6. The phone is about 6” tall and 3” wide. It is slim and sleek looking. It has dual cameras. The rear camera is 12 MP and the front one, 8 MP. The Moto G6 comes with 32 GB of internal storage than can be expanded by adding a micro SD card. This phone is updated to Android 8.0.0 currently. So far, I’m very satisfied with the Moto G6.

Moto is ONLY TF that UPDATES! G6 has UPDATED Android Oreo OS 4 security fixes in 1 week = Security. Don't be tempted by the LG STYLO bigger screen. G6 Screen is big enough & Pixels are better in Moto G6, and with ALL THAT RAM, Everything RUNS SMOOTHER! I have (Installed 242 Apps) NOT A MISTAKE! No Stalling! Text to Speech, for 1st time is Deadly Accurate like DNS V15. Google Commands more easily understood. I have 3x the Music, 3x as many Apps running and it moves flawlessly between Apps with no wait time. In Oreo, You CONTROL PERMISSIONS, not the App which means an END TO ROBOCALLS that need your Identity & Phone number to operate, this Ends Apps Constantly Restarting & wearing down Your Battery. Only Older Apps not meant for Oreo will not let you control Permissions.

So much better than my Samsung G4 ever was. I love this phone! Instead of spending $800 on another Samsung phone that had issues, I decided to try the Moto G6 and I'm hooked. Better camera, faster, better sound. I can't think of a single way my SG4 was ever better than this phone! And it comes unlocked to boot. I do have to mention my first Moto G6 was a lemon and repeatedly rebooted. I sent it back with no hassle and this one works great!
This seems to be Sprints sales hook to lock you in as a customer for a year or so with a Sprint only locked phone. Please Amazon stop listing the Moto G6 or G7 as Sprint compatable.

Love Moto G Phones. I got my brother and mom these budget Moto G6 phones and they are awesome for the price. I am a big fan of Motorola's Moto G series phones and the fact they run practically stock Android OS. Got these running Android OS 9.0 Pie and they are quick!

Moto has poor life.. I had two of these a Motorola g4 and a Motorola G6. I got them over a. Of time after giving my wife my old Huawei. So I've been through two Motorola's going to Hawaii still works better. Motorola starts off good but then there's trouble with the touch screen, poor telephone coverage, sending text messages, and generally erratic behavior. I'm getting a Galaxy 10. I don't recommend the Moto phones.

Tracfone has come a long way. And this phone shows it. This is a real deal, genuine, 100% functionality Moto G6. 3GB ram, 32 GB internal storage (which you can further increase with an SD card for TRUE integrated storage. Right now my phone has NINETY SIX gigabytes of internal storage). and all the same processing power as the other carriers that make you pay up to 1/3 more. I also have its cousin, the Moto G6 Play, which for the version on Virgin has only 2 GB ram and 16 GB storage (although thankfully that's less important here due to Motorola actually integrating your SD card). The G6 Play, however, has an absolutely massive battery capacity (4000 MAh), which this phone sorely lacks. I could get twice as much time without charging compared to this model. The G6 Play also has a Corning Gorilla Glass 3 back. The G6, at least through Tracfone, does not.

At least go for the 4gb version. Had this phone since October 2019~i prefer this over moto g5 plus but I woultn recommend the 3gb ram 32gb version to anyone. It's horrible slow... 3gb ram doesn't cut anymore. At least get the 4gb 64gb version if you're planned to get a moto g6. The one thing I miss from this phone now that I've upgraded to a samsung a71 are the nice bezels on this phone. Also the moto g6 has superior face recognition tech, it recognizes my face now often and faster than the a71 lol.

Id recommend this moto G6. Only had my motoG6 for a week but i am very pleased so far. The camera is amazing and audio is good. I love the turbo charge feature and so far I've had no issues with it in any way
I’M IN LOVE, ALL SHOOK UP!. Moto G6, so lovely, so nice, so quick, so slippery, I dropped it, it’s fine, its not, the back shattered, let’s get a case, case on, it’s so lovely, so nice, so quick.

The best phones I had. This is the third Amazon Prime I've had, previously I had the Moto G4, the Moto G5+ and not the Moto G6. The phones are great they've never failed me, even when I've failed them (pool accident, but the G5 was up and running a few hours later). I hope Amazon keeps working with Motorola to offer great phones at a great price.

Second Motorola Android phone. I previously had a Moto G4 and loved it. But after 2 and half years the battery would use its charge too quickly and the battery was non-replaceable. The price and the features on the Moto G6 are great. I would never pay the price for an I-phone. And this phone has all the features that I want.

Bang for the buck!!!. I recently bought the Moto G6 and compared it to the Samsung S9 and the Apple X. I will say this: you get the most for your money with the Moto. Yes, I agree the top shelf phones are excellent and surely superior to the Moto overall. However, the Moto gives you 95% of the performance of the top flagship phones at 20-30% of the cost. This is outrageously good value for money. Seriously, if you need the social status and snob appeal of the flagship phones and have serious excess cash, please keep buying these over priced smartphones. If you need a great phone at a small fraction of the cost and don't need a phone to boost your low self esteem or your perceived social status, then the Moto G6 fits the bill perfectly!

Sturdy phone with decent features, bootloader not unlockable. My only complaint is that the Prime exclusive model's bootloader will not unlock, unlike all the other Moto G6 model. This is not the one for modders.

This phone is junk!. I don't know if I just got a lemon or not but it has had really bad reception from day one. I also have a Moto G5 plus and sitting side by side the G6 gets half as many bars! and the G5+ has a nicer screen. This was a Prime buy phone and as far as I'm concerned I Just wasted my money!

For any important calls, I just use my headset. Calls in the car of course kind of work, but the connection instability is a regular problem and bluetooth seems to make it worse. Motorola is clearly aware of this - it's all over their forums - but they don't seem to be doing anything to fix it. My wife has this issue with her G6 too and her mom had it with her G5 and G6. None of us are going to buy any Moto GX phones again.

The cameras are not iPhone X or S9 quality but they do have a pro mode and take very good pictures even for the most critical shutterbugs. The G6 runs like a top. Very fast and smooth from screen to screen and app to app. The voice quality with calls is a little off but easily remedied with the built in Dolby speaker adjustments. Overall, you can't loose with the G6. Motorola does a fine job of bridging the gap between the flagship phones and the budget minded buyer. I refuse to spend $1000 on a phone that can't take a 20 inch fall. Do yourself and your wallet a favor and get into a new Moto, you won't be disappointed.

Great for the price. Really good phone for a affordable price. I had the Moto g6 play, but this one is so much better. I love the fingerprint scanner, the camara is great and the battery last long enough.

Love My Moto G6. My last phone was an S7 from a competitor. The battery never lasted long. I really love this phone. It is bigger and because I use google products there was little to no learning curve!

I came from a Samsung S5 Active(terrible phone) that I had to carry a battery backup with me just to make it through the day. I can use my Moto G6 all day and not worry about plugging in. I would buy this phone again and again with no reservations.

This observation does NOT detract from my 5 STAR review. Overall, in my opinion, the Moto G6 is functionally equal in all respects to the iPhone 8 with the exception of the iWatch cellular interface, but at 30% of the overall cost.

Done with MOTOROLA. Bought this to replace a previous g6 that had battery issues. Worked fine for 8 months when the touchscreen stopped responding... know better now, done with Motorola... both phones had issues within 1 year. Used to be able to remove battery on some phones then reinstall and fixed the problem... this phone can not be opened to access battery.

Great Phone & Great Price. I had to turn in my iPhone 6s when I left my previous employer and very satisfied with the Moto G6. Rather than spending $$$ on a new iPhone, this G6 does everything I need it to do, and has plenty of storage at 64GB. I had no issues getting this activated at the VZ store. So far it's a great phone and I don't feel like I downgraded from the iPhone. Works as good or better.

A decent Android phone.. The G6 is a decent Android phone. There are better Androids out there, but not for this money. I was using an iPhone 6S, which I feel is a much faster phone than the G6. Some apps seem to take forever to open on the G6 compared to the iPhone, and the iPhone 6S is several versions old. On the plus side, you can put an SD card in the G6 for more memory. That's nice. The fingerprint reader is much more sophisticated than the fingerprint reader on the iPhone. A big plus there. The phone itself is thin and light--makes the iPhone 6S feel like a brick. The G6 screen is nice, unless you hold it up to an iPhone, then you see the difference. The camera on the iPhone 6S can't compete with the camera on the G6. The G6 camera app is far superior, too.

Stuck in Airplane mode.. If AT&T is your carrier, DO NOT BUY THIS PHONE. The Moto G6 is incompatible with that carrier. I purchased this phone back in July. It actually worked as a phone until Moto pushed down a security patch in September. After that the phone was stuck in Airplane mode hell. I followed the instructions to fix this issue on the Moto site, nothing works. Even a factory reset on it didn't work. Now it's a dead phone, that I use strictly for gaming. It's worthless for anything else. The fingerprint button has never remembered my prints longer than 24 hrs and the battery goes from 100 to 0 in less than 3hrs. In short the Moto G6 is a terrible phone. You.S. Cellular and AT&T don't support it, Sprint told me the same thing.

Best phone we've ever had.. My wife really liked my moto 2 so I bought her the g6. Very impressed with the phone and even though it comes with all the Amazon apps, it's not that big of a deal. She absolutely loves this phone.

Love the 32 gigs of srorage.. Had Tracfone for years and this is the best one by far. Does everything I need it to do and has performed well so far. A Tracfone that updates it's operating system is a real plus. Love the Moto G6!

Affordable great smart phone. It's a great phone which has all the features have sane as iphone. I had been using Iphone since day one and this phone does everything plus better battery life. I'm very happy to have Moto G6
Crashes abruptly!. My Moto G6 phone keeps crashing randomly for no reason. Even though I love the phone it has crashed 7 times since last night. Highly not recommended!

02_dense.text: The G6, at least through Tracfone, does not. This difference makes the phone feel disappointingly insubstantial and light. The phone has great functionality, handling every app I throw at it with aplomb. Motorola's gesture support is really fun to use, allowing you to screenshot with a "3-finger salute", flick your wrist to activate your camera, or shake your phone like a Maglite to activate the flashlight. Another difference, weirdly enough, is in the charging ports. The G6 Play uses a USB micro connection, whereas the G6 uses the new "standard" (USB-C) that isn't as common as it likely will be in the future. That means your old micro USB plugs will not work. Sound quality is pretty good, although it could be a tad louder. Motorola tends to have a lot of complaints about faulty sound drivers in their phones, but thankfully this one avoided that curse.
